historical_record.description: A permit was sought for a three-storey frame building of 18 apartments with a basement, estimated at $32,000. J. C. Hladik was named as architect.

The tenants of 940 and 942 Hayes Street formed a union in October 1969; by November 33 of the 38 units were withholding rent, and on 25 November the landlady signed an agreement with them setting out repairs, trust funds and arbitration.
